title: Spook breakfasts and McShann's nickname Hootie
summary: Spook breakfasts were all-night jam sessions; 'spook' meant ghost, and Jay McShann was Hootie for staying up like an owl.

story.theme_name: How I got my name: nicknames and band monikers
story.community_name: How I got my name: nicknames and band names

blocks.x: Yeah. And that was anybody who'd stay up all night. We called them spooks, you know.
Well, I thought that was an insulting term for blacks.

And sometimes it was, you know, but not understood as that in Kansas City. In what's his name -- the term that was used in Kansas City was more or less the ghost, you know, the spook. Anybody who stayed up that late was a ghost.

Well, for example, if I can give you a little turn of my life, the name Jay McShann has, Hootie, you know, now they used to say that he'd drink some whisky and then he would hoot like an owl, you know. He'd stay up so late that he was up with the Hoot owls.
Oh, it has nothing to do with hootch then?
No. It was like he was up with the owls all night.
Yeah, like old Hootie, you know. That owl, he's out there again tonight.
But he did have a reputation for drinking, too, didn't he?
Well, we'll come to him. Let's go on
